Metta Victor, The Dead Letter.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/metta-victor/the-dead-letter

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Metta Victor, author, died 1885.

First publication of the text used: 1866 (SE colophon: 'The Dead Letter was published in 1866 by Metta Victor.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1866, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die did so in 1885). So the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
